description.value: Iona Beach Regional Park is a Metro Vancouver regional park situated on the Iona spit in Richmond, extending into the Strait of Georgia near the mouth of the Fraser River. The park offers expansive views of the ocean, mountains, and the Vancouver skyline, making it a notable destination for cyclists exploring the Fraser River delta area. It is managed by Metro Vancouver as part of the regional parks system.
